If you play "LOTERIA®" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.

992.body:
"$2 MILLION VAULT" offers a top prize of $2 million and twelve prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward many smaller prizes. Games shaped like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

Everything above about "$2 MILLION VAULT" comes from the North Carolina Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.

993.body:
"$5,000 Triple Play" has gone five months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About three-quarters of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $5,000 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

The numbers for "$25,000 Triple Play" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.

995.body:
"$200,000 Triple Play" is well into its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

Every line of $200,000 Triple Play's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
